boundary.scanLimits: Scans skip symbolic links and stay within size limits

agentPanel.title: AI Agent activity
agentPanel.start: Open the AI Agent page to start a task.

overview.title: Project overview
overview.subtitle: A live map of your account, repositories, AI and tasks
overview.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Keeping the last data and stopping activity animation. Retry to reconnect.
overview.partial: Some task or AI data is unavailable. Activity animation is paused.
overview.noRepositories: No synced repositories. Connect and sync GitHub first.
overview.gesture: Scroll to zoom · Drag to pan · Click a node for output
overview.polling: Task records refresh every 3 seconds; lines indicate task activity

evolution.title: Collaboration and maintenance
evolution.subtitle: Plan, develop and verify isolated candidates with clear recovery and approval.
evolution.goalPlaceholder: Describe the change and how to verify it.
evolution.disclosure: I allow selected project context to be sent to these model providers.
evolution.trustedConsent: I trust this project’s local scripts. This mode is not an operating system sandbox.
evolution.strictUnavailable: No verified strict isolation host is configured. This mode will block execution.
evolution.noWorkflows: No workflows yet. Choose a project and describe a task to begin.
evolution.candidateOnly: Candidate verified. Applying, installing or publishing needs a separate action.
evolution.recoveryDetail: Inspect checkpoints before resuming. Uncertain writing steps cannot be replayed automatically.
evolution.memoryDetail: Each project keeps its own sources, dated facts and clearly marked inferences.
evolution.clearMemoryDetail: This removes this project’s memory and its memory backups. Project source files remain intact.
evolution.indexLimited: The index reached its file or size limit. It is not a complete project inventory.
evolution.noMemory: No memory yet. Update the index to start.
evolution.resourceDetail: Measured resource pressure limits admission of new work; active work is not silently discarded.
evolution.networkNotProbed: Network connectivity is not probed by this view.
evolution.selfDetail: NEXUS uses an independent maintenance policy and a separate development workspace. Candidate generation never authorizes installation.
evolution.selfPolicyConsent: I confirm this independent self-maintenance policy.
evolution.updateDetail: Check release metadata, download full installers and verify their hash and trusted publisher.
evolution.publisherMissing: No trusted signing publisher is configured. Installation remains blocked.
evolution.hashVerified: Downloaded bytes match the release SHA256.
evolution.installationGate: Installation is unavailable until the trusted publisher and native confirmation process are ready. This action only downloads and verifies.
evolution.researchDetail: Approved source-backed proposals can become isolated development workflows. Approval alone is not completion.
evolution.noResearch: No source-backed proposals yet. Run research and review its licenses first.
evolution.targetModules: Target modules, one relative path per line
evolution.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Recorded data is retained; retry when the service is available.
